opening_phone_call: ^Oh. You picked up. I wasn't sure you would.
^Oh uhh I just… wanted to check on you. It's been a while.
^I was listening to the radio the other day and they mentioned Oudaya...
^Reminds me of when I was a kid playing with Khadija, we always got lost in the medina.
^I'd like to see it again, but I don't think I will... I don't think I... can.
^The doctors say the treatment could be working but...
^They say one thing, but you feel another.
^Would…or can..can you go there? Maybe take a photo of my neighborhood and show me what changed.
^It's been years since I last visited…
^I wonder if Khadija and Allal still live there...
^I love you. I always have. We just never said it much.
